objective: Measure the daily semantic review and repair stage (Jev review, isolated confirmation, bounded HY3 repair, follow-up review, per-slot acceptance) on real corpus days at the current revision, with a blind human adjudication subset for meaning preservation and grounding.

sample_unit.unit: one real dated corpus run once through run_daily_briefing.py --jev-review-dir at the frozen revision
sample_unit.readers: schema_version 3 semantic audits only; audits at schema 1 or 2 are excluded, never migrated
sample_unit.corpus_source: corpora restored with restore_private_corpora.py from the authenticated encrypted archive, or the day's fresh fetch_news.py corpus; the fourteen-date private retention window bounds how many dates one restore can supply
sample_unit.exclusions: a day whose fallback chain reaches no ready candidate contributes a generation-failure row and no review metrics; a day whose review status is partial or failed contributes to the coverage denominator and to no rate conditioned on complete review

sample_size.sizing_prior: docs/results/jev-preliminary-2026-09-30.md: 7 of 10 same-day HY3 reports had at least one confirmed included finding and received a repair round; 12 of 220 included topics carried a confirmed included grouping finding; 17 of 21 initial flags were confirmed in isolation. These are a single-day pilot's observations, used only to choose n.
sample_size.interval_rule: two-sided 95% Wilson interval, computed with evaluator.metrics.wilson_interval, reported with successes and trials for every rate
sample_size.clustering: topics and checks within a day are not independent; topic-level and check-level rates are reported with day-clustered bootstrap intervals alongside their Wilson intervals

metrics: flag_rate: initial flags over returned checks, and days with at least one flag over days with complete initial review
confirmation_rate: confirmed over initial flags; disputed and unconfirmed reported separately
repair_round_rate: days with at least one repair target over days with complete review
per_slot_acceptance: apply_repair over repaired slots, with withhold_repair, failed and skipped causes by allowlisted code
publication_outcome: original_retained, repaired_applied, partial_applied per day
followup_blockers: re-flagged checks on repaired slots by check kind, including two-position checks that block both slots
cost: reported USD per phase per day, unknown-cost calls, days stopped by an estimated spending guard

human_adjudication.reviewers: two human reviewers independent of the run, plus a third human adjudicator for material disagreements; no model review substitutes for a human label
human_adjudication.repair_pairs: every repaired slot (applied or withheld) as an original/repaired pair; both sides independently shuffled; both reviewers label every pair
human_adjudication.control_topics: per day, order unflagged included topics by SHA256(protocol_id + report_date + section + position) and take the first three; one reviewer labels all, the second labels the first third rounded up
human_adjudication.blindness: packets carry frozen title/excerpt evidence and prose only; they omit model and provider names, Jev scores and labels, repair status, file paths, and which side of a pair is the original

rubric.support: every material claim supported by the supplied frozen excerpts; identify unsupported, strengthened, or reversed claims
rubric.meaning_preservation: for a pair, whether the repaired prose preserves the original's supported meaning; identify lost, added, or changed material claims
rubric.citations: each retained source relevant to the prose; identify irrelevant retained sources and relevant removed sources
rubric.readability: complete sentences, no copied truncated fragments

human_adjudication.disagreements: retain both labels; adjudicate from blinded evidence and rationales only; report raw agreement and adjudicated outcomes separately with exact denominators

commands.command_notes: The restore refuses a non-empty output directory and, without --artifact-dir, would contact GitHub with a token; each day therefore restores from the preserved wrappers into its own corpora directory. The daily runner exits 0 even when the review stage raises, so the runner script requires review/audit.json after a ready chain and stops otherwise. --generation-usd bounds each day's generation spend below the daily default of USD 25. The preservation manifest lacks workflow_run provenance, which the restore requires; run_jev_stage.py joins manifest.json with inventory.json into .news-briefing/jev-stage/artifact-manifest.json and passes --artifact-manifest.

privacy: commit the protocol, aggregate counts, per-day artifact SHA-256 values, and reviewer agreement only; corpora, frozen excerpts, prompts, raw judgments and packets stay in ignored directories
limits: Jev judges feed excerpts, not articles. Confirmation is repeat agreement from one judge. Human labels cover repaired slots and a small control sample, not every topic, so no overall miss rate is claimed. Days drawn from one retention window are consecutive and share source health. HY3 repair behavior at temperature 0.2 is not deterministic across reruns of the same day.

revision.rule: The run revision is the clean HEAD of the branch at the first day run; it must be a descendant of frozen_from_commit that changes no file under agent_runner/, news_fetch/, or the root pipeline modules except through the commits that freeze this protocol and its documents. run_jev_stage.py records `git rev-parse HEAD` in every day record and ledger row; the model card reports that commit and this freeze commit.

post_freeze_pipeline_commits.scope: freeze commit: agent_runner.audit_metrics clustered intervals, agent_runner.audit_packets rubric, run_jev_stage.py
run_jev_stage.py builds the provenance manifest for restore_private_corpora.py; no change to the review or repair stage
restore_private_corpora.py conflict error names the date and wrappers; run_jev_stage.py keeps the newest wrapper per day; no change to the review or repair stage

revision.note: The review and repair stage under test (agent_runner.jev_review, agent_runner.semantic_repairs, agent_runner.decisions, run_daily_briefing.py) is byte-identical to frozen_from_commit; the commits above touch only the restore path and the evaluation runner, and are listed so the run commit's ancestry is explicit.

sample.note: Dates were inventoried from preserved wrapper creation dates without decryption; the frame is an upper bound on obtainable days and missing days remain in the coverage denominator.

cost.planning_estimate_usd: roughly 0.15 to 0.35 per day from the September 30 study (about 0.05 per generation plus review, confirmation and repair), so 4 to 10 for 28 days; the ceiling is about 36 for 28 days and the guards are estimates, not provider-enforced caps

status_note: Frozen on 2026-10-16 before any day ran. The aggregator (agent_runner.audit_metrics) and blind packet exporter (agent_runner.audit_packets) exist and are tested against fixture review directories; both read schema-3 audits only.
